text: This report provides the Audit Results, as prepared by KPMG, to assist the Board in reviewing the financial statements for the year ended 2020-12-31. The Audit Results Report was reviewed and discussed at the Policy and Finance Committee meeting on 2021-05-13 and was received for information.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo received the report (May 25, 2021) from the Director, Finance and Technology, Toronto Zoo, for information
